cases.name: Start-up: health check, database, dashboard
cases.observed: health 200 in 1 ms ({'status': 'ok', 'database': 'up'}), dashboard 200 in 4 ms

cases.name: Administrator starts a run with new models, the worker finishes it
cases.expected: Done, results and models stored, flagged list filled
cases.observed: status done, 3,244 sessions stored, 49 flagged, test precision 1.00, recall 1.00, F1 1.00

cases.name: Analyst workflow: list, session, assistant, user page, report
cases.expected: Every step works and is logged
cases.observed: task completion 6 of 6 steps (all worked), log entries {'session_viewed': 1, 'assistant_question': 1, 'user_viewed': 1, 'report_viewed': 1}

cases.name: Access control (the login throttle is checked last, in IT4b)
cases.observed: {'analyst asks for a run': 403, 'no token': 401, 'expired token': 401, 'plain HTTP when HTTPS is required': 426}

cases.name: Bad input: missing file, missing column, wrong date, repeated ids and labels without an event
cases.expected: Runs stop with V1, V2 and V3, the warnings run finishes
cases.observed: {'bad_no_device': ('failed', True), 'bad_column': ('failed', True), 'bad_date': ('failed', True), 'warn_duplicates': ('done', True)}, results kept after the failed runs: True

cases.name: Session edges: 12-hour cap, events outside sessions, overlapping sessions
cases.expected: Cap at 21:00, outside events dropped, the overlapping session not compared with the open one
cases.observed: {'run done': True, '12-hour cap': True, 'only the in-session web visit counted': True, 'overlap not in the baseline': True}

cases.name: Reliability: same data again, worker stopped during a run, MongoDB stopped
cases.expected: Same scores, the stopped run is marked failed, 503 with a clear message and recovery
cases.observed: {'same scores without retraining': True, 'stopped worker: shown as running, then failed': True, 'database stopped: 503, then back': True, 'worker still running after the outage': True}, message while down: 'The database is not reachable. Start MongoDB and try again.'

cases.name: SPEDIA through the whole chain
cases.expected: The run finishes and results are stored
cases.observed: status done, 246 sessions, test precision 0.94, recall 0.94, F1 0.94

cases.name: Speed: API response times (30 calls each) and page load in a browser
cases.observed: {'list': 'median 4.9 ms, p95 9.8 ms', 'detail': 'median 2.7 ms, p95 3.0 ms', 'user history': 'median 5.2 ms, p95 6.1 ms', 'latest run': 'median 1.7 ms, p95 2.1 ms', 'offline chat': 'median 2.0 ms, p95 2.6 ms'}, slowest 10 ms, page load {'login_page_ms': 657, 'flagged_list_ms': 222}
